messages:
Marta (SRE): Quick postmortem follow-up: recurring short p95 spikes yesterday around peak traffic. Pattern: hot callers + cache churn led to p95 ~1.5s for 8-12m windows. Need owners for remediation and a safe SLO response.

Dev (Platform): Agreed. Two parallel mitigations: 1) narrow fallback for non-enterprise keys (quantized variants + rate-limit heavy callers) and 2) permanent fix (cache TTL stabilization + request shaping).

Luis (Service Owner): For enterprise tenants we must avoid silent degradation. Can we scope fallback to labeled public keys only and keep SLAs intact?

Sofia (Product): Yes. Product will produce the enterprise list and comms template. Also want a short timeline for when we revert any temporary SLOs.

Marta (SRE): Proposal: temporary SLO window 14 days: public-hosted p95 <= 300ms (was 200ms) applied only to non-enterprise keys. If 72h burn-rate > 1.4 -> pause non-critical rollouts. Keep p99 unchanged. Prefer degradation over loosening SLA.

Dev (Platform): I'll implement a 2% canary to quantized variants for public keys today; expand to 10% if 24h burn-rate > 1.5. Also add label-based routing and a per-key rate-limit for top callers.

Luis (Service Owner): I'll draft the degradation policy for /generate and /embed (which features are reduced) and mark which endpoints are enterprise-exempt. ETA 48h.

Marta (SRE): Action items: - Marta: add p95 burn-rate alert + playbook snippet to SLO dashboard (today) - Dev: 2% quantized canary + routing rules (today) - Luis: degradation policy + enterprise exemptions (2d) - Sofia: comms template + customer-impact mapping (tomorrow)

ops-bot: Created calendar event "SLO mitigation checkpoint" Mon 09:30 PT and alert group p95 burn-rate > 1.2 -> notify #eng-sre + oncall.

Dev (Platform): Added PromQL to dashboard PR: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, api_key, route)). Also added a top-callers CSV export.

Marta (SRE): I've updated the runbook: on short spike -> enable degraded path for public keys -> notify owners -> reassess after 24h. Will add the postmortem and action tracker link shortly.

Sofia (Product): I'll coordinate with Sales for any enterprise customer outreach. Post updates in this thread when owners confirm.

Luis (Service Owner): Noted. I'll sync with Dev on safe rollout to avoid config drift.

Marta (SRE): Closing: follow-up sync in 24h. Prefer graceful degradation over SLO loosening; temporary SLO is a last-resort safety valve.
